cube_kmeanspp.diagnosis: The positive exact pair-aggregation remainder alone reverses the weakest-pair reference sign; Assumption 4 small-r_pair transfer budget is not satisfied at the frozen margin.

reacher_kmeanspp.diagnosis: Affine-reference geometry favors regional modeling, but trained regional predictors have higher same-cache loss than Global. The primary break is before planning: configuration-dependent specialization/estimation cost and/or actual-model discrepancy (Assumptions 4 and 3), not lack of affine response separation.

same_cache_loss_caveat: The trainer evaluates on the same regional cache used for optimization and selects checkpoints by this loss. These values diagnose realized optimization/model cost but are not independent held-out generalization estimates.
assumption5_status: Not isolated by this audit. Reacher does not require an Assumption 5 failure to explain the sign because the trained one-step model comparison already favors Global. PushT remains a candidate for a dedicated held-out trained-model and planning-link audit.
